explain: Only a completed authoritative empty scan supports removing absent records. A failed or partial scan must not silently clear the active corpus.
steps: Record scan completion and authority independently of item count. || Permit deletion reconciliation only when both guarantees hold.
name: scan-outcome

explain: A listed page cursor and a committed processing checkpoint mean different things. A failure after listing must not advance the restart boundary.
steps: List the next page without changing the durable checkpoint. || Advance the checkpoint only after the fixture's page processing succeeds.
name: checkpoint

explain: A location identifies where bytes came from while a content digest identifies which bytes were processed. Equal URLs do not establish equal content.
steps: Hash downloaded synthetic bytes. || Compare the digest after changing the file while retaining the same location.
name: source-digest

explain: Reconciliation compares authoritative source identities with indexed state and finds missed additions and deletions. Watcher events alone cannot guarantee completeness.
steps: Build source and index identity sets. || Calculate the required upsert and remove operations.
name: reconciliation

explain: Discovery, fetching, extraction, and ingestion produce different intermediate artifacts. Separating them helps identify the first bad transformation.
steps: Model a listing record separately from downloaded bytes. || Decode text and prepare an indexed object while retaining source identity.
name: source-stages

explain: Resolving a candidate path and verifying its permitted root prevents a basic traversal. Real file access also needs defenses against symlink races and an OS-enforced boundary.
steps: Resolve root and candidate before comparing ancestry. || Reject a parent-directory traversal without opening a file.
name: path-boundary

explain: A retryable rate limit pauses progress rather than activating a partial crawl. Redirect and destination checks remain separate controls.
steps: Classify the synthetic response status. || Preserve the previous checkpoint when the source asks the client to retry later.
name: crawl-policy

explain: Recognized text and usable document structure are different outputs. A requested field must retain its row/header association rather than being chosen solely because its characters are correct.
steps: Keep line labels with recognized values. || Select amount_due instead of the first number on the page.
name: extraction-quality
